paragraphs: R' Shabbatai. Sanhedrin's first chapter, 8a: R' Hanan said; some say R' Shabbatai. Also Almanah Nizonet. Rav Ashi said that R' Shabbatai said: they accept testimony in a litigant's absence. R' Yohanan questioned this: Bava Kamma 112b. It appears this was the earlier Rav Ashi, since R' Yohanan questioned it. R' Shabbatai transmitted in R' Yitzhak of Magdala’s name [Niddah 27b also gives the reverse attribution]. Niddah 46a: R' Keruspedai bar R' Shabbatai; Sanhedrin 69a: R' Keruspedai said that R' Shabbetai said. Heilprin summarizes Tosafot, Gittin 11, as calling Shabbatai a gentile name and Shabbetai a Jewish name. Tosafot specifically calls Shabbatai an evil spirit. This needs examination, for it is difficult to emend all the aforementioned places that have Shabbatai.
